scope: Right-turn enriched diagnostic candidates; not confirmed labels or representative evaluation. Human must label intervals; collision motion may be UNKNOWN. Training overlap not audited.
method: Ranked 1500 CCD videos by median horizontal flow on frames 0,8,16,24,32 at 160x90, median over rows 15:60. Inspected sequential contact sheets of top 24 at frames 0,10,20,30,40. Selected 5 plausible ego-right-turn candidates.
